## Primary owner (one person)
Karan / Patricio / Joint integration DRI:

## Workstream
ACQUISITION / MANUFACTURING / INTEGRATION / PLATFORM:

## Canonical path
Which existing module and files will change?

## Existing capability / duplication check
What already exists? Link to the registry entry, code and related issues/PRs.

## Exact deliverable
What input, output and behavior will this task produce? What remains out of scope?

## Dependencies
Other work, issue numbers, or cross-team decisions needed first:

## Acceptance tests and evidence
How will both engineers know it works and doesn't fabricate or misattribute information?

## Confidentiality / deployment impact
Does it touch a public fixture, private data, secrets, Cloudflare production, or the shared contract?
